acceptanceCriteria: Each addition has a requirement, fixture and golden compile output pinned to CompilerVersion.
Path synthesis uses only admitted edges and reads UNKNOWN otherwise.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Verified limits of the slice: compile.go:146 always enters at flow.Steps[0], compile.go:343-366 fixtures take no arguments and return nothing, catalog.go:254 rejects parameterised URLs, catalog.go:219 admits only three matchers. V1 adds E2 fixture outputs and data flow, E3 session, E4 teardown, E5 typed locators and assertions, parameterised routes, path synthesis over admitted edges, and E7 test.step plus trace.
title: CCE V1: block vocabulary (session, fixture outputs, parameterised routes, path synthesis, teardown, typed locators)
